topics.title: Meaning and stages of remote sensing

concepts.learning_objective: Define remote sensing and identify its three basic components.
Sequence the stages of remote sensing data acquisition from energy source to map.
Identify the regions of the electromagnetic spectrum used in remote sensing.
Explain why different objects respond differently in different spectral regions.
Describe how atmospheric constituents absorb and scatter reflected energy.

topics.title: Remote sensing satellites and data reception

concepts.learning_objective: Compare sun-synchronous and geostationary satellites by altitude, coverage, resolution and use.
Describe how image data is received, corrected and converted into maps.
Describe the working of a whiskbroom scanner.
Explain and calculate the detector array of a pushbroom scanner.

topics.title: Resolving powers and sensor resolutions
topics.ncert_sections: Resolving Powers of the Satellites; Sensor Resolutions; Table 6.1

concepts.learning_objective: Explain temporal resolution and its use in change detection.
Distinguish spatial, spectral and radiometric resolution using Table 6.1.
Distinguish images from photographs and describe photographic images.
Explain pixels and digital numbers in a digital image.
Classify elements of visual interpretation into image and terrain characteristics.
Interpret tones and colours of features on a standard false colour composite.
Apply texture, size, shape, shadow and pattern to identify features.
